title: Conversations in Mall World
content: I find I don't interact with a lot of people in my mall world, I'll have people around me sometimes but it's kinda vague small talk. On very rare occasions I'll end up in a secluded area with someone I know well (or at least I seem to know well in the dream, sometimes they are people I know in real life but also people who seem to only exist in mall world but they feel familiar) and we end up some kind of deep or intense discussion, I never remember what it's about but I know I can't speak. Like it feels like there is peanut butter in my throat and I can't communicate anything. These dreams are pretty stressful and I wake up panicky. I've found I can tap into lucidity a little bit with it and there's a few things I consciously do in the dream to try and communicate more clearly via gestures and can kind of wake myself up but it's starting to become a little unsettling. Anyone else experience this with attempting to verbally communicate in mall world?
